data.title: Term 1 check: Listening and Speaking
data.course: HEC IELTS Speaking & Listening · Year 1 · Term 1
data.subtitle: Lesson 12 · 60 minutes
objectives: Listening: follow a conversation and a short talk, and note exact details.
Speaking: answer Part 1 questions with reasons and talk for one minute on a cue card.

questions.title: Questions 1–6
questions.instructions: Complete the booking form. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

teacher.title: Script
lines: Assistant: City Museum bookings, good afternoon.
Parent: Hello, I'd like to book the workshop where children make paper lanterns.
Assistant: Of course. We run it on Saturdays and Sundays, but Sunday is full this month.
Parent: Saturday is fine. What time does it start?
Assistant: Quarter past two, and it finishes at four.
Parent: There will be three children. The surname is Lam, L-A-M.
Assistant: That's a hundred and twenty thousand each, so three hundred and sixty thousand in total.

teacher.title: Marking
lines: One mark each. Accept 2:15 and 14:15. Spelling must be correct for question 5.

teacher.title: Script
lines: Speaker: Good evening. Our new library was meant to open in January, but the builders needed more time, so the doors will open in March.
Speaker: Anyone may visit, though children under ten need to come with an adult. You don't need a card to read here, only to borrow.
Speaker: The ground floor is for families. If you want to study, the quiet room is right at the top, with a view of the river.
Speaker: You can take home six books at a time, for three weeks.

blocks.heading: Interview: home and free time
paragraphs: The examiner asks four questions. Answer each with a reason and a detail.

items.q: Can you tell me about the place where you live?
What do you usually do after school?
Is there a hobby you would like to start? Why?
Do you prefer spending free time alone or with friends?

teacher.title: Marking (2 marks per answer)
lines: 2 · A direct answer, a reason and a detail; easy to follow.
1 · An answer and a reason, or needs one prompt.
0 · One word, or does not answer the question.
Record the score; do not tell the student a band.

blocks.heading: Cue card: a person who helped you
paragraphs: You have one minute to make notes, then talk for one minute.

lists.title: Describe a person who helped you learn something. You should say:
items: and explain why you remember it.

teacher.title: Marking (12 marks)
lines: Content (4) · covers all four points with details.
Organisation (3) · a clear start, middle and end.
Language (3) · past tenses mostly correct; some linking words.
Fluency (2) · keeps going for the full minute.
